cues.en: The Witness is all about perspective. It's the only conclusion that I can think of that pulls it all together.

cues.zh: 这是一款关于反复体验事物、每次都能看到不同东西的游戏。
cues.en: It's a game about experiencing things multiple times and seeing something different each time.

cues.zh: 我爱这款游戏。我也恨它。
cues.en: I love this game. I also hated it.

cues.zh: 我觉得你应该玩它。我也觉得你不该玩它。
cues.en: I think you should play it. I also think you shouldn't play it.

cues.zh: 我不是在故弄玄虚或故意刁难，
cues.en: I'm not trying to be coy or difficult,

cues.zh: 这就是我对这款游戏的矛盾心情，在几次写稿失败之后，
cues.en: this is simply how conflicted I am on the game and after failing to write the script several times,

cues.zh: 我认定唯一能写完的办法，就是诚实到自相矛盾的地步。
cues.en: I've resolved that the only way I can get through it is to be honest to the point of being contradictory.

cues.en: This video will spoil everything about this game.

cues.en: Reviews have purposefully omitted several important features; I will not be doing that.

cues.zh: 如果你有一丁点打算玩这款游戏，
cues.en: If you have the slightest intention of playing this game,

cues.zh: 不管是下周玩，还是一年后打折时玩，那就别看了这个视频。
cues.en: whether it's a week from now or a year when it goes on sale, then do not watch this video.

cues.zh: 这不是评测，而且这款游戏最好盲玩。
cues.en: This is not a review, and this game is best played blind.

cues.zh: 在开始玩《The Witness》之前，我已经有两个问题想弄明白：
cues.en: I already had two questions I wanted answered before I started playing The Witness:

cues.zh: 第一个是：“为什么它叫‘The Witness’？”
cues.en: the first was, "Why is it called 'The Witness?' "

cues.zh: 第二个是：“这款游戏如何在整个流程中让划线谜题保持有趣？”
cues.en: The second was, "How is the game going to keep line puzzles interesting for its entire duration?"

cues.zh: 在玩了50个小时之后
cues.en: After playing the game for 50 hours

cues.zh: 我可以在这里回答这个问题，
cues.en: I can answer this question here with,

cues.zh: 而第一个问题我只能给出一个猜测
cues.en: And I can only propose a guess for the first one

cues.zh: 原因很不巧，太复杂了，后面需要单独一节来讲。
cues.en: for reasons that are, unfortunately, so complex that it needs its own section later.

cues.zh: 那么我们就直接进入《The Witness》最大的部分：玩法。
cues.en: So let's get right to it with what is the biggest chunk of The Witness: gameplay.

cues.zh: 游戏的开始方式和《Infinifactory》一样；没有标题画面，没有可选项，
cues.en: The game starts like Infinifactory does; no title screen, no selecting anything,

cues.zh: 你启动游戏，加载完成后，就直接被放到游戏的起点。
cues.en: you launch the game and after it loads, you're put right at the start of the game.

cues.zh: 你完全不知道自己身在何处，也不知道要去往何方，
cues.en: You have no idea where you are or where you're going,

cues.zh: 游戏甚至都还不信任你，连转身的能力都不给你。
cues.en: and the game doesn't even trust you with the ability to turn around yet.

cues.zh: 你只能向前走，默默经历它无声的新手引导。
cues.en: you have to walk forward and go through its silent tutorial.

cues.zh: 关于这款游戏如何教会你各种机制，已经有很多讨论了，
cues.en: A lot has been said about this game's ability to teach you mechanics

cues.zh: 它不靠弹窗教程，也不靠手把手帮忙。
cues.en: without pop-up tutorials or a helping hand.

cues.zh: 你只能自己去推断眼前这些谜题的规则。
cues.en: You're left to infer the rules of the puzzles being presented to you on your own.

cues.zh: 所以一开始，规则简单到只是从起点画一条线到终点。
cues.en: So at the start, it's as simple as drawing the line from the beginning to the end.

cues.zh: 然后会加入一些简单的限制，规定你该怎么画这些线。
cues.en: Then there are simple modifiers to how you draw those lines that you have to follow.

cues.zh: 这里的谜题都很短，所以一旦出错，你可以很快重试。
cues.en: The puzzles here are short, so when you make a mistake, you can quickly try again.

cues.zh: 这部分与其说是在教你如何解开这些单独的谜题，
cues.en: This part of the game is less about teaching you how to solve these individual puzzles,

cues.zh: 不如说是在为你打基础，让你能自己琢磨出如何解开每一个谜题。
cues.en: and more about laying the foundation for you to be able to work out for yourself how to solve EVERY puzzle.

cues.zh: 游戏是否成功做到了这一点，我们后面会聊。
cues.en: Whether the game succeeds in doing this is something we'll be talking about.

cues.zh: 你还会学到，有些谜题能解锁东西。
cues.en: You're also taught that some puzzles will unlock things.

cues.zh: 这里，霓虹线会引导你走向下一块面板，
cues.en: In this case, you're led around by neon wires to the next panels,

cues.zh: 最终通向那扇锁住的门。
cues.en: which eventually end to the locked gate.

cues.zh: 你打开它，整座岛就向你开放了。
cues.en: You open it, and now the whole island is available to you.

cues.zh: 岛上有11个主要谜题中心，你可以按任意顺序挑战，
cues.en: There are 11 main puzzle hubs that you can approach in any order,

cues.zh: 不过游戏确实会先试着引导你去特定区域。
cues.en: although the game does try to guide you towards select areas first.

cues.zh: 这条路上有两个支线区域，我第一次通关时都探索过。
cues.en: There are two side areas along this path that I explored my first time through.

cues.zh: 现在，我们先停在其中一个：一个远比你之前见过的任何谜题都复杂的谜题，
cues.en: For now, let's stop at one of them; a puzzle that is far more complex than anything you've seen so far,

cues.zh: 里面的形状和概念你还没接触过。
cues.en: with shapes and concepts you haven't had to deal with yet.

cues.zh: 你可以试着解它，但教你这条谜题规则的面板就在附近，
cues.en: You can try to solve this but the panels that teach you the rules of this puzzle are nearby,

cues.zh: 所以我觉得，这里的用意是让大多数玩家放弃，沿着路去学规则，
cues.en: so the idea here, I think, is that most players will give up and follow the path to where they learn the rules,

cues.zh: 然后带着解开这个谜题所需的知识再折返回来
cues.en: and then turn around and go back now that they have the knowledge necessary to open this puzzle

cues.zh: 这是在试图教玩家：如果某个东西超出了你的能力，你也许该考虑
cues.en: This is trying to teach the player that if something is beyond them, that they might want to consider

cues.zh: 先去别处，再回来。也许你还没学到那一课。
cues.en: going somewhere else, and then coming back. Maybe they haven't learned a lesson yet.

cues.zh: 到目前为止还不错吧？那我们继续。
cues.en: So far, so good right? Well, let's continue.

cues.zh: 附近有两个区域，我认为是游戏里最简单的一组谜题，
cues.en: There are two areas nearby that have what I consider to be the easiest set of puzzles in the game,

cues.zh: 果园系列和海边那组镜像线条。
cues.en: the orchard series and the seaside set of mirrored lines.

cues.zh: 我先去了后面那个区域，完成之后才继续前进。
cues.en: I went into the latter section first and completed it before moving on.

cues.zh: 这部分相当有趣，需要大胆猜测才能看出你得利用谜题背后的背景
cues.en: This was fairly enjoyable and required a leaping guess to see that you have to use the background behind the puzzle

cues.zh: 作为线索来解开其中一些谜题。
cues.en: as a guide to solve some of them.

cues.zh: 虽然我很快就想通了，但我觉得这一点对玩家的传达很差，
cues.en: Even though I worked this out quickly, I think this is poorly communicated to the player

cues.zh: 而且和之前的内容偏离太大，没法合理地被推导出来。
cues.en: and is too big of a departure from what came before it to be reasonably worked out.

cues.zh: 果园里的环境要素在这方面做得好得多，
cues.en: The environmental aspects in the orchard do a much better job of this,

cues.zh: 所以如果游戏是想让你先去那里，那还情有可原，
cues.en: so it might be forgivable if the game wanted you to go there first,

cues.zh: 但游戏本来就不必做成开放岛屿，所以这也没那么情有可原。
cues.en: but then the game didn't HAVE to be an open island, so it's also not that forgivable.

cues.zh: 这片区域的其余部分很不错。我喜欢最后这一系列谜题，它把镜像概念玩出了新花样
cues.en: The rest of this area is good. I liked the final series here that twists the mirror concept

cues.zh: 让你凭记忆复现谜题的布局。
cues.en: by having you repeat the puzzle layouts from memory.

cues.zh: 之后，一个盒子打开，向岛屿对面的山顶射出一道激光。如果你是真人，这事件足够让你好奇
cues.en: After this, a box opens and shoots a laser beam across the island to a mountaintop. If you're human this will be a curious enough event

cues.zh: 于是你会跟着激光走到山顶，看看究竟是怎么回事。
cues.en: that you will follow the laser to the mountaintop to see what that's all about.

cues.zh: 途中你会经过几个区域，最终抵达那里。
cues.en: You'll pass a few areas on your way and eventually arrive there.

cues.zh: 所以这就是游戏的目标：找到更多激光射向这座山。
cues.en: So this is the goal of the game; to find more lasers to shoot at this mountain.

cues.zh: 我觉得这一点传达得相当清楚，不过这里还发生了更重要的事。
cues.en: I think it's conveyed fairly well, however something far more important happens here.

cues.zh: 有一个线条谜题，什么作用都没有。
cues.en: There's a line puzzle that doesn't do anything.

cues.zh: 那是一条弯曲的线，你可以反复描画，但毫无效果。
cues.en: It's a curvy line that you can draw over and over; it does nothing.

cues.zh: 我画了三次，然后向前走，想看看这到底是怎么回事。
cues.en: I drew it three times, and then stepped forward to see what it was all about.

cues.zh: 我看到下面那条河看起来像谜题，就点了它。
cues.en: I saw the river below that looked like the puzzle, so I clicked on it.

cues.zh: *这*就发生了，我大喊，
cues.en: *This* happened, and I yelled,

cues.zh: 游戏里还有更多这样的谜题，
cues.en: There are more puzzles like this in the game,

cues.zh: 我仔细梳理了事件顺序
cues.en: and I've gone through the sequence of events carefully

cues.zh: 尽量不破坏超出必要的部分，
cues.en: in order not to ruin any more than I had to,

cues.zh: 因为我觉得至少有一些一直在看的人
cues.en: because I think there might be at least a few people who kept watching

cues.zh: 以为这游戏只有面板谜题。
cues.en: who thought the game only had panel puzzles.

cues.zh: 如果这种事让你现在对这游戏感兴趣了，
cues.en: If this sort of thing has made you interested in the game now,

cues.zh: 这是你最后的机会暂停视频，以免看到更多剧透。
cues.en: this is your last chance to stop the video to avoid even more spoilers.

cues.zh: 就像最近很多其他游戏一样，
cues.en: Like so many other games lately,

cues.zh: 我见过有人把《见证者》和《黑暗之魂》在教你东西方面做比较。
cues.en: I've seen the witness compared to Dark Souls in regards to teaching you things.

cues.zh: 但就连《黑暗之魂》也会放下留言和NPC来引导你获取信息。
cues.en: But even Dark Souls will put messages and NPC's down to guide you with information.

cues.zh: 你也可以在游戏前中期磕磕绊绊或硬闯过很多遭遇
cues.en: You can also stumble or brute-force your way through a lot of encounters in the early and mid-game

cues.zh: 之后再吸取教训，同时还能继续推进，
cues.en: and learn lessons later while still progressing,

cues.zh: 而在《见证者》里，如果你撞了墙，游戏就抱起胳膊说：“不行，没门！”
cues.en: whereas if you hit a wall in the witness the game crosses its arms and goes, "Nope, nuh-uh!"

cues.zh: 不给出它想要的确切答案，就不让你通过这片区域。
cues.en: And won't let you progress through this area until you give it the exact answer that it wants.

cues.zh: 说来好笑，更贴切的比较是这游戏的难度。
cues.en: The more apt comparison, funnily enough, is the game's difficulty.

cues.zh: 它滋生了那种我在《黑暗之魂》里讨厌的精英主义态度，
cues.en: It fosters that same elitist attitude that I HATE about Dark Souls,

cues.zh: 尽管我正是为了那种难度才爱这游戏的。
cues.en: even though I love the game specifically for that difficulty.

cues.zh: 总是很容易搬出“你就是菜！”这个借口，
cues.en: It's always so easy to point to the "You're just bad!" excuse,

cues.zh: 或者那种“我通关了，所以过不了的人就是垃圾”的立场，
cues.en: or the stance that "I got through it, so anyone [else who] doesn't sucks,"

cues.zh: 这话是想把游戏抬到批评之上？我……
cues.en: which is meant to somehow elevate the game above criticism? I...

cues.zh: 我不知道他们怎么会这么想。
cues.en: I don't know how they think that.

cues.zh: 没多少《黑暗之魂》或《见证者》的粉丝会这样，但确实存在。
cues.en: Not many Dark Souls or Witness fans do this, but it does happen.

cues.zh: 我见过一些非常合理的游戏批评因此被否定。
cues.en: I've seen some very legitimate criticism of the games be dismissed because of it.

cues.zh: 如果我们回到起点区域附近的那片果园，
cues.en: If we go back to that orchard near the starting area,

cues.zh: 你能看到游戏正试图教你观察环境来找线索。
cues.en: you can see that the game is trying to teach you to look at the environment for hints.

cues.zh: 这里的树枝大致模仿了视野中的那棵树，而你唯一能利用的其他信息
cues.en: The branches here sort of mimic the tree that's in view and the only other information you have to work with

cues.zh: 就是其中一根树枝上有个苹果。
cues.en: is that one branch has an apple.

cues.zh: 所以正确的目标是让苹果和画上的苹果对应起来。
cues.en: So the correct goal is to match the apple on the drawing.

cues.zh: 我立刻就明白了这一点，但我已经去过山上，也看到了那条河的线条。
cues.en: I figured this out immediately, but I had already gone to the mountain and seen the river line.

cues.zh: 如果我们去看 Super Bunny hops 的评测，你能看到他在这一点上卡住了。
cues.en: If we go to Super Bunny hops review, you can see him struggling with it.

cues.zh: 他并不笨，他只是被游戏训练得去关注那些面板，并在那里解决问题，
cues.en: And he's not a stupid guy, he's simply being conditioned by the game to focus on the panels and solve it THERE,

cues.zh: 而不是去环境里寻找任何线索。
cues.en: and not to look for anything in the environment yet.

cues.zh: 人们在他视频的评论里为此批评他；不算多，但确实有。
cues.en: People have criticized him for this in the comments on his video; not a lot, but it's there.

cues.zh: 有些人正是因为这种设计而喜欢这款游戏，当你被教导用某种方式去看待事物，
cues.en: Some people love the game for this sort of thing, when you're taught to look at something in a certain way,

cues.zh: 再从不同的角度去看它，那个“咔哒”一下的瞬间，或者说“啊哈”时刻，
cues.en: to see it from a different perspective, the "click" moment, or the "a-ha" moment,

cues.zh: 我就是那类人。这正是我喜欢这款游戏的地方。
cues.en: and I am one of those people. That's what I loved about this game.

cues.zh: 我常常感到有挑战性，而当这种挑战是公平的时候，
cues.en: I often felt challenged and, when that challenge was fair,

cues.zh: 解决了让我卡住的问题，我会非常满足。
cues.en: I was very satisfied that I solved something that had me stumped.

cues.zh: 即使是在你周围岛屿的某些部分找到可以画线的位置，
cues.en: Even with finding lines to draw on parts of the island around you,

cues.zh: 这款游戏的绝大部分仍然聚焦于面板谜题。
cues.en: the vast majority of this game is still focused on panel puzzles.

cues.zh: 这些可以归结为两种非常简单的方式，每一种都在挑战你：
cues.en: These can be boiled down to two very simple ways that each one of them challenges you:

cues.zh: 第一，识别并理解规则，或者说代码，取决于你想怎么称呼它。
cues.en: First, to identify and understand the rule, or the code, depending on what you want to call it.

cues.zh: 第二，应用那条规则或代码，找到符合它的正确迷宫路径。
cues.en: Secondly, to apply that rule or code and find the correct path through the maze that adheres to it.

cues.zh: 就是这样。《The Witness》中90%的游戏内容就是这些。
cues.en: That's it. That's 90% of the game in The Witness.

cues.zh: 当它在引入新规则并教你这些规则方面做得足够好时，
cues.en: And when it does a good enough job in introducing new rules and teaching them to you,

cues.zh: 你会把大部分时间花在尝试找出解法上。
cues.en: you'll spend most of your time trying to work out the solution.

cues.zh: 而这几乎总是没问题的。你懂规则，只需要把它们运用起来。
cues.en: And this is ALMOST always fine. You know the rules, you just need to work through applying them.

cues.zh: 当游戏无法与你沟通，或者抛出一个新概念却没有任何前置信息时，
cues.en: It's when the game fails to communicate with you, or introduces a new idea without any prior information,

cues.zh: 才会变得极其令人沮丧。
cues.en: that it becomes monumentally frustrating.

cues.zh: 你只能盯着某个东西，它简直像外星人造的，完全无法理解，
cues.en: You're left staring at something that may as well be created by aliens for how incomprehensible it is,

cues.zh: 或者更糟的情况是，当游戏的引导没有发挥应有的作用，
cues.en: or, at worst, when the game's introduction doesn't work as well as it should,

cues.zh: 或者直接跳过概念，指望你在毫无准备的情况下也能跟上。
cues.en: or leaps forward with the concept and expects you to make a similar leap without preparation.

cues.zh: 我其实不怎么卡关，
cues.en: I didn't get stuck very often,

cues.zh: 我觉得这更多是运气，而不是因为我有多聪明或多敏锐。
cues.en: I think this is more due to luck than any amount of intelligence or perception on my part.

cues.zh: 在沙漠区域，我很快就注意到，从某个角度看时，太阳会抹掉面板上的线条，
cues.en: In the desert area I noticed very quickly that the sun will erase lines on the panels

cues.zh: 改变你的视角。
cues.en: if viewed from a certain angle, changing your perspective.

cues.zh: 我能生动地想象，没注意到这一点的人可能会经历怎样的挫败感，
cues.en: And I can vividly imagine the frustration someone who doesn't notice this might go through,

cues.zh: 以及当他们终于弄明白时，这种感觉又如何变成厌恶。
cues.en: and how it could turn into a repulsion when they finally do figure it out.

cues.zh: ——他们可能会哭出来
cues.en: - they'll probably cry

cues.zh: 但正因为我注意到了这一点，这里最终成了我在游戏中最喜欢的区域之一。
cues.en: But because I did notice it this ended up being one of my favorite areas in the game.

cues.zh: 这也是我在评价它时如此纠结的众多原因之一。
cues.en: Which is one of many reasons why I'm so conflicted when it comes to judging it.

cues.zh: 要说我真正卡住的地方，得从沙漠之后的采石场说起。
cues.en: For a place that I did hit a wall, we have to go to the quarry after the desert.

cues.zh: 进入这个区域的入口之一是一组两扇门。
cues.en: One of the entrances into this area is a set of two doors.

cues.zh: 第二扇门上有两个L形，就这些。它告诉你的全部信息就这些。
cues.en: The second one has two L shapes, and THAT'S IT. That's all the information it's telling you.

cues.zh: 这是我第一次见到这种类型的方块。
cues.en: This was the first time I had seen these types of blocks.

cues.zh: 11个区域中我还没提到的最后一个，是岛屿中央的小镇。
cues.en: The final area of the 11 that I haven't spoken about yet is the town in the middle of the island.

cues.zh: 这里融合了你在整个游戏中学到的所有经验，
cues.en: This combines all the lessons you learned throughout the game,

cues.zh: 却不幸被放在了最容易到达的位置，
cues.en: and is unfortunately placed in the most accessible location,

cues.zh: 导致我能想象许多玩家在这里会遇到一些令人沮丧的时刻。
cues.en: leading to what I can imagine to be some frustrating moments for many players.

cues.zh: 这里有些谜题时好时坏，而且并不总是因为这个原因。
cues.en: Some of the puzzles here are hit and miss, and not always for that reason.

cues.zh: 我觉得玩家最终意识到这是最终区域是合理的，
cues.en: I think it's fair for players to eventually realize that this is meant to be the final area,

cues.zh: 但即便如此，有几个谜题需要你先解开这个区域里的谜题
cues.en: but even then, a handful require you to have already solved the puzzle in THIS area

cues.zh: 才能变得可解，这招真的很损。
cues.en: before they become solvable, which is a really mean trick.

cues.zh: 利用解开这里某个谜题后得到的玻璃门，去看旁边另一个谜题的真实颜色，
cues.en: Using the glass door from solving a puzzle here to see the true colors on another next to it,

cues.zh: 或者必须从屋顶上看这个红色面板谜题，而屋顶要从另一个谜题解锁，
cues.en: or having to look at this red panel puzzle from the roof that unlocks from another puzzle,

cues.zh: 但在此之前，他们会在附近放一些看起来很可疑的阴影
cues.en: but not before they put some suspicious-looking shadows nearby

cues.zh: 来骗你以为那是真正的提示
cues.en: to trick you into thinking they're the real hint

cues.zh: 而实际上，那是个阳光眩光面板，就像沙漠里那样。这个挺损的。
cues.en: when in reality, it's a sun glare panel, like in the desert. This one is pretty mean.

cues.zh: 但这个区域也有整个游戏里对我来说最精彩的时刻之一
cues.en: But then this area also had one of the best moments in the entire game for me

cues.zh: 当它在一个封闭房间里使用彩色灯光时。你必须改变颜色，而且……
cues.en: when it uses colored lights in a closed-off room. You have to change the colors, and...

cues.zh: ……嗯，我玩的时候尽量不依赖纸笔，但我觉得这可能是少数几个
cues.en: ...Well, I tried not to rely on pen and paper much while I played but I think this might be one of the few cases

cues.zh: 不用纸笔就根本不可能完成的例子之一。
cues.en: where it's impossible NOT to use it.

cues.zh: 如果真有人凭记忆做到了这个，那我真是佩服得五体投地，机器人竟然已经厉害到
cues.en: If someone out there did this by memory, then I am incredibly impressed that robots have gotten so good

cues.zh: 能冒充人类了。
cues.en: to pass as humans.

cues.zh: 对我来说，画出网格、并制定一条所有符号对每种颜色做出反应的规则，让我觉得非常有成就感。
cues.en: For me, I found it very satisfying to write out of a grid and make a rule about all the symbols reacting to each color.

cues.zh: 这之后的谜题也绝不是轻松就能过的，所以这是个很棒的挑战。
cues.en: The puzzles aren't pushovers after this either, so it was a great challenge.

cues.zh: 通关之后我又做了一些。你只需要完成七个区域就能到达终点，
cues.en: I did some of these after finishing the game. You only need to complete seven areas to get to the end,

cues.zh: 也就是十一个激光箱中的七个，每个地点做够谜题后就能打开。
cues.en: seven of the eleven laser boxes that you open after doing enough puzzles in each location.

cues.zh: 这会解锁通往山里的路，并进入最后的谜题序列。
cues.en: This unlocks the way into the mountain and through the final sequence of puzzles

cues.zh: 我真的真的非常喜欢这个区域，喜欢到你现在可能在想：
cues.en: I really, really enjoyed this area to the point, that you might be thinking right now,

cues.zh: “靠，Joe，你说你心情矛盾，但到目前为止，你可真是夸个不停啊。”
cues.en: "Well, shit, Joe, you said you were conflicted, but so far, you sure are gushing a lot."

cues.zh: 我知道，我保证我们会谈到这一点。我想公平一点，既展示这款游戏做得好的地方，
cues.en: I know, and we'll get to that, I promise. I want to be fair and show what the game does well,

cues.zh: 也展示它做得差的地方。
cues.en: just as much as it does badly.

cues.zh: 在这个区域，谜题开始瓦解，我的意思是，围绕它们的规则开始崩坏。
cues.en: The puzzles begin to disintegrate in this area, by that I mean the rules that surround them begin to crumble.

cues.zh: 有些人可能会认为这是人为制造的难度，因为面板会被遮挡，妨碍你的视线，
cues.en: This could be seen as artificial difficulty by some since panels will be covered to obscure your view,

cues.zh: 或者会移动，让你操作起来很别扭。
cues.en: or will be moving to make it awkward.

cues.zh: 但这些已经足够直截了当，算是一个很酷的变化。
cues.en: But these were straightforward enough that it was a cool twist.

cues.zh: 真正让我享受的是更深入的那些谜题。
cues.en: It was the puzzles farther in that I really enjoyed.

cues.zh: 那个颜色错乱的系列，我得用手在显示器上挡住一些，
cues.en: The series with the broken colors that I had to use my hands to block some of them on my monitor

cues.zh: 才能看出哪些以相同模式闪烁，相当不错。
cues.en: to see which ones flashed in the same pattern was pretty good.

cues.zh: 那条让你用同一条线解决新谜题的道路就更棒了。
cues.en: The road that has you solving new puzzles but with the same line was even better.

cues.zh: 最后以双光桥收尾，
cues.en: And it's capped off with the dual light bridge,

cues.zh: 我认为这是创意与挑战平衡得最好的谜题之一。
cues.en: Which is what I consider to be one of the best balanced puzzles in terms of creativity and challenge.

cues.zh: 最后的房间是地板上的形状，柱子部分就没那么好了，
cues.en: The final rooms were the shapes on the floor and the pillars aren't as good,

cues.zh: 但它们在结尾提供了新东西，只是变化不够大，
cues.en: but they provide something new at the end that isn't a grand enough departure

cues.zh: 不足以破坏你已经学到的概念。
cues.en: to corrupt concepts you've already been taught.

cues.zh: 然后你乘着珍珠般的电梯离开那个天使般的区域，飞越岛屿，
cues.en: Then you leave the angelic looking area in a pearly elevator and fly over the island

cues.zh: 对一些人来说，这就是游戏的结局了。
cues.en: for what will be the end of the game for some people.

cues.zh: 这就是这款游戏的大部分玩法。
cues.en: That's most of the gameplay in this game.

cues.zh: 对于那些玩过很多次 The Witness 并想知道的人，
cues.en: For those who have played The Witness a lot, and are wondering,

cues.zh: 我确实继续玩了，并看到了隐藏结局，
cues.en: I DID continue playing and see the hidden ending,

cues.zh: 还完成了那个带限时音乐挑战的挑战洞穴。
cues.en: and completed the challenge cave with the time-to-music gauntlet.

cues.zh: 我用了大约25个小时通关电梯结局，解开了380个谜题，
cues.en: I got this ending with the elevator in about 25 hours with 380 puzzles solved

cues.zh: 还找到了38个环境图案。
cues.en: and 38 of the environmental patterns found.

cues.zh: 之后我又玩了25个小时，几乎达成了100%完成度。
cues.en: I played for another 25 hours after that for almost 100% completion.

cues.zh: 从这里开始，我的思路就没那么有条理了。
cues.en: My thoughts from here get a little less structured.

cues.zh: 我必须谈谈游戏的创作者，还有剧情，以及它与那些环境谜题的关联。
cues.en: I have to talk about the game's creator, and the story as well as tying into those environmental puzzles.

cues.zh: 我知道这期视频很长，所以如果你想休息一下再回来看，现在正是时候。
cues.en: I know this video is long, so if you want to take a break and come back to it, now would be the time.

cues.zh: 我觉得，如果不讨论这款游戏的创作者，我就不适合详细谈论它。
cues.en: I don't think it's right for me to speak in detail about this game without discussing its creator.

cues.zh: 《The Witness》是由Thekla Incorporated开发的，但最常被归功于游戏创作的是Jonathan Blow。
cues.en: The Witness was developed by Thekla Incorporated, but it's Jonathan Blow that you'll hear most often attributed to the game's creation.

cues.zh: 我觉得有必要提到他们，原因有两个。
cues.en: There are two reasons that I feel obligated to bring them up.

cues.zh: 第一个不那么重要的原因是，Jonathan Blow 是促使我萌生做这个 YouTube 频道想法的众多人之一。
cues.en: The first, less important reason is that Jonathan Blow is one of many people that got me thinking about making this YouTube channel.

cues.zh: 我看过他的几场演讲，每次都被他的观点深深折服。
cues.en: I've watched several of the talks he has given and been consistently impressed by what he has to say.

cues.zh: 第二个更重要的原因是，其他谈论这款游戏的人似乎都免不了要提到他。
cues.en: The second, more important reason is that everyone else who speaks about the game can't seem to avoid bringing him up either.

cues.zh: 而这种情况之所以出现，直接关系到我对这款游戏的看法。
cues.en: And why that's happening ties directly into how I feel about this game.

cues.zh: 事实是，如果你对电子游戏足够感兴趣，以至于会看我频道的视频，
cues.en: The fact of the matter is that if you're interested enough in video games to be watching a video on my channel,

cues.zh: 那你多半听说过 Jonathan Blow，而单凭这一点就很不简单了。
cues.en: then you've probably heard of Jonathan Blow, and that alone is significant.

cues.zh: 你还听说过多少其他游戏开发者不止一次？
cues.en: How many other game developers have you really heard of more than once?

cues.zh: 我敢打赌，大多数游戏爱好者能叫出名字的游戏总监数量，
cues.en: I'd wager that most gaming enthusiasts would struggle to name the same amount of game directors

cues.zh: 和同等水平的影迷能说出的电影导演数量相比，恐怕会相形见绌。
cues.en: as the equivalent person could about film.

cues.zh: 这些名字很少在讨论中被提及
cues.en: These names are rarely brought up in discussion

cues.zh: 假设我错了，Jonathan Blow 是制作《Braid》的那个人，
cues.en: Assuming that I'm wrong Jonathan blow is the guy who made Braid,

cues.zh: 一款早在2008年推出的2D解谜平台游戏。
cues.en: a 2D puzzle platformer that came out way back in 2008.

cues.zh: 许多人声称它是那一年发布的最重要的游戏之一，
cues.en: Many people claimed it was one of the most important games to be released that year,

cues.zh: 而且它是第一款真正证明独立游戏确实值得你花时间的游戏。
cues.en: and it was the first game that really proved that indie titles could be truly worth your time.

cues.zh: 我并不完全同意这些说法
cues.en: I don't necessarily agree with all that

cues.zh: 我在《Braid》发售的那个月就玩了，
cues.en: I played braid the same month it came out,

cues.zh: 我怀念它，但并不觉得它是游戏界的一大事件。
cues.en: and I remember it fondly, but not as a big event in gaming.

cues.zh: 我觉得我从 Jonathan Blow 的演讲中获得的收获比从他的游戏里更多。
cues.en: I think I've gotten more out of Jonathan Blow's presentations than his games.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么我非常犹豫要不要说出我接下来要说的话。
cues.en: And that's why I'm really hesitant to say what I'm about to say.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么我在开场时说我只是需要诚实。
cues.en: It's why I said in the opening about how I just need to be honest.

cues.zh: 我刚才解释关于《Braid》的一切、它的反响，以及人们谈论《The Witness》的原因
cues.en: The reason I just explained everything there about Braid, its reception, and people talking about The Witness

cues.zh: 是因为我无法摆脱一种感觉：Jonathan Blow 在耍我们。
cues.en: is that I can't shake the feeling that Jonathan Blow is fucking with us.

cues.zh: 我认为有三个重要理由，先从我觉得最有力的一个说起。
cues.en: I have three big reasons for thinking this, and I'll start with what I think is the strongest one.

cues.zh: 《见证者》是一款被过度吹捧的平板游戏，就玩法而言，很难证明它40美元的定价合理。
cues.en: The Witness is a glorified tablet game that does little to justify its $40 price tag when it comes to gameplay.

cues.zh: 我知道你可能在想，
cues.en: And I know you might be thinking,

cues.zh: “你刚刚还夸了它那么多，怎么能这么说？”
cues.en: "How can you say that after you just got done praising so much of it?"

cues.zh: 你说得对，这确实矛盾，
cues.en: And you're right that it's contradictory,

cues.zh: 但即便如此，如果这些面板是以选择界面的形式呈现在一个同样只要10美元的平板界面上，
cues.en: but I still would have enjoyed the vast majority of this game just as much

cues.zh: 这款游戏的绝大部分内容我依然会同样享受。
cues.en: if the panels had been presented to me in a selection screen on a tablet interface that also cost $10.

cues.zh: 而且用那种界面画线，说不定还更容易些。
cues.en: Drawing the lines would have arguably been easier with that interface, too.

cues.zh: 游戏实在没多少次能充分利用环境，来证明自己配得上是一款大型3D冒险游戏，
cues.en: There simply aren't enough times that the game uses its environment in ways that justify it being a big 3D adventure

cues.zh: 即便是沙漠和神庙这类确实做到了的区域，
cues.en: Even some of the areas that do, like the desert and temple sections,

cues.zh: 也完全可以用巧妙的方式在平板上模拟出来。
cues.en: could have been simulated with clever ways on a tablet.

cues.zh: 环境没有被充分利用。最能证明这一点的，就是游戏确实开始利用它的时候，
cues.en: The environment isn't used enough. Nothing proves this more than when the game DOES start using it,

cues.zh: 到了后期，《见证者》终于开始像一款真正的电子游戏了。
cues.en: toward the end, when The Witness finally starts feeling like an actual video game.

cues.zh: 就在你快通关的时候，却被踢了出来。
cues.en: Right before you're done, and kicked out.

cues.zh: 山地区域非常精彩，就像岛上的迷宫和堡垒一样。
cues.en: The mountain section is fantastic, just like the mazes and the fort elsewhere on the Island.

cues.zh: 但真正出彩的是你激活全部11个激光后解锁的秘密洞穴区域。
cues.en: But what really stands out is the secret cave section that you unlock after you activate all 11 lasers.

cues.zh: 然而，即便在这里，你也能看到游戏未能达到其自身世界水准的例子。
cues.en: Even here, however, you see examples of the game not living up to its own world.

cues.zh: 这里有一排排谜题面板，完全没有以任何方式利用环境。
cues.en: There are lines of puzzle panels here that don't use the environment in any way.

cues.zh: 它们只是让你穿行而过，镜头拉近，
cues.en: They're just there for you to move through, camera zoomed in,

cues.zh: 反正看起来也就像个平板游戏。
cues.en: in what might as well be a tablet game anyway.

cues.zh: 通过这里之后，你会到达一个限时区域，必须学会穿过一系列随机化的谜题。
cues.en: After you get through here you arrive at a section where you're timed, and have to learn to move through a series of randomized puzzles.

cues.zh: 我觉得有个迷宫得靠看之前的谜题板才能学会，
cues.en: There's a maze that I think you have to learn by looking at an earlier puzzle board,

cues.zh: 但我不太确定。
cues.en: but I'm not sure.

cues.zh: 记住线条在哪儿接上符号，似乎能帮我过关。
cues.en: Remembering where the line picked up the symbols seemed to help me get through it.

cues.zh: 播放的音乐就是你的时限，催着你赶紧。
cues.en: The music playing is your time limit and urges you to rush.

cues.zh: 在面板之间移动很重要，拼命记住
cues.en: Movement between panels is important, as is frantically remembering

cues.zh: 游戏教过你的所有课程也同样重要。
cues.en: all the lessons that the game has taught you.

cues.zh: 这是我在游戏里最喜欢的一段。我在很多不同方面都感到了挑战。
cues.en: This was my favorite part of the game. I felt challenged in so many different ways.

cues.zh: 通关时我觉得自己征服了什么。
cues.en: I felt like I had conquered something when I beat it.

cues.zh: 然后，游戏就结束了。
cues.en: And then, the game was over.

cues.zh: 《The Witness》号称有超过500个谜题，
cues.en: The Witness boasts that it has over 500 puzzles

cues.zh: 而我觉得真正有趣地利用了周围世界的也就100个出头，
cues.en: when I'd say that barely more than 100 truly utilized the world constructed around them in an interesting way,

cues.zh: 连那些画直线的面板都算进宣传数字里，这也挺侮辱人的。
cues.en: that some of the draw-straight-line panels count toward that advertised number is also Insulting.

cues.zh: 这个环境怎么说呢？它很美，
cues.en: And what can I say about that environment? That it's beautiful,

cues.zh: 它和游戏整体关于视角、观点或“看待方式”的主题紧密相连，
cues.en: that it ties into the rest of the game's theme on perspective, outlooks, or [points of view],

cues.zh: 随便你怎么称呼它们。
cues.en: whatever you want to call them.

cues.zh: 岛上塞满了隐藏图像，只有从特定角度才能看到。
cues.en: The island is crammed with hidden images that you can only see from certain angles.

cues.zh: 水中的倒影里，树根变成了鱼；烧毁的小屋中藏着一个人，
cues.en: Roots that become fish in the water's reflection, a person hiding in a burned hut,

cues.zh: 雕像彼此伸手相触。
cues.en: statues reaching for each other.

cues.zh: 到后期，我觉得自己可能开始看到根本不存在的东西了。
cues.en: I think I might have started seeing things that weren't even there toward the end.

cues.zh: 从某些角度看，这些树开始像那些异乡人。
cues.en: These trees began to look like the foreign people to me from certain angles.

cues.zh: 这个地方经过精心设计，只有你找对角度，它才会显露真相。
cues.en: The place is carefully structured the only reveal things if you're looking at it right.

cues.zh: 看着已经看过的东西，却看到了全新的内容，
cues.en: Seeing the same thing you've already looked at, but seeing something completely new,

cues.zh: 就像你终于在谜题中看到了解法一样。
cues.en: just like when you finally see the solution in a puzzle.

cues.zh: 这就是《The Witness》的核心所在，
cues.en: This is what The Witness is all about,

cues.zh: 但这一切美景，都比不上你在游戏里盯着面板浪费的时间。
cues.en: but all this beauty isn't worth how much wasteful panel staring you'll be doing in the game.

cues.zh: 那环境谜题呢？你在岛上找到的那些圆圈，可以从中画出形状？
cues.en: But what about the environmental puzzles? The circles you find in the island that you can draw shapes from?

cues.zh: 就是我在这期视频第一部分提到的那个“我靠！”时刻。
cues.en: The "Holy shit!" moment that I mentioned in the first part of this video.

cues.zh: 它们隐藏的方式和所有这些图像一样，
cues.en: These are hidden in the same way as all these images,

cues.zh: 而它们的摆放方式，
cues.en: and the way that they've been placed,

cues.zh: 既显而易见又巧妙伪装，往往堪称天才。
cues.en: somehow obvious and camouflaged at the same time, is often nothing short of genius.

cues.zh: 有人可能会说，找到这些图案才是《The Witness》真正的游戏，
cues.en: Some people might argue that finding these patterns is the actual, REAL game in The Witness,

cues.zh: 而面板只是用来让你有事可做的干扰物，
cues.en: and that the panels are just a distraction placed to keep you busy

cues.zh: 直到你终于开始观察周围的世界。
cues.en: until you finally start looking at the world around you.

cues.zh: 我觉得没那么极端。我认为两者同等重要。
cues.en: I don't think it's as extreme as that. I think they're both equally important

cues.zh: 我认为游戏试图传达的信息，以及所谓的剧情，
cues.en: I think message the game is trying to convey, and what passes as a story,

cues.zh: 更多与环境谜题有关，但我们稍后会讲到。
cues.en: has more to do with the environmental puzzles, but we'll get to that.

cues.zh: 是你在游玩时体验到的不同视角，
cues.en: are the different perspectives that you experience while playing it,

cues.en: but I don't really care enough to find out.

cues.en: You have no memory because you have a rebirth of sorts when you enter the program.

cues.en: There are some hints that the whole thing is meant to be able to teach you something.

cues.zh: 我们先停一下，聊聊故事。
cues.en: Let's pause for a second and talk about stories.

cues.zh: 我想把它们汇总起来，分成四个类别，
cues.en: I want to pull them all together and make four different categories

cues.zh: 做一张非常简化的图表，把所有写过的故事都能归进去。
cues.en: and make a very simplified chart that EVERY story EVER written can be put into.

cues.zh: 那么一边，是我们讲述的故事本身。
cues.en: So, on one side, we have the story that's being told.

cues.zh: 它是简单的故事，还是复杂的故事？我们只需知道这个。
cues.en: Is it a simple story, or is it a complex story? That's all we want to know.

cues.zh: 我们不关心它讲什么、角色是谁或其他任何东西，只关心"它是简单的叙事还是复杂的叙事？"
cues.en: We don't care what it's about, or the characters, or anything else, other than "is it a simple narrative or a complicated one?"

cues.zh: 接下来是同样的两个特质，但用在另一个方面：
cues.en: Next up we have the same two qualities, but on a different part;

cues.zh: 这个故事是以简单的方式讲述，还是以复杂的方式讲述？
cues.en: is this story TOLD in a simple way or a complex way?

cues.zh: 它是否有一个直截了当、可靠、不怎么绕弯子的叙述者，
cues.en: Does it have a straightforward, reliable narrator who doesn't mess around much

cues.zh: 不会用过分华丽的语言，也不会跑题之类的？
cues.en: with overly-flowery language or go off on tangents and the like?

cues.zh: 讲得是否清楚，还是塞满了各种杂乱的信息
cues.en: Is it clearly told, or is it filled with lots of different information

cues.zh: 和复杂难读的段落，充斥着大量文字游戏之类的东西。
cues.en: and complex paragraphs that are difficult to read with lots of word play, stuff like that.

cues.zh: 我们不关心这个做得好不好，暂时不在乎，
cues.en: We're not interested in whether or not this is well done, we don't care for now,

cues.zh: 我们只想判断这个故事是怎么讲的。
cues.en: We just want to determine how the story is told.

cues.en: So with these categories, we can form four distinct types of stories:

cues.zh: 用简单方式讲述的简单故事，
cues.en: A simple story that is told in a simple way,

cues.zh: 用简单方式讲述的复杂故事，
cues.en: a complex story that is told in a simple way,

cues.zh: 用复杂方式讲述的复杂故事，
cues.en: a complex story that is told in a complex way,

cues.en: and a simple story that is told in a complex way.

cues.en: Three of these categories, in my mind, can work in wonderful ways.

cues.zh: 其中最好的，大概是用简单方式讲述的复杂故事。
cues.en: The best of them all is probably a complex story told in a simple way.

cues.zh: 几乎任何人都能读懂，而且每次都能发现新东西。
cues.en: almost anyone can read it and they can discover new things each time.

cues.en: That complexity is something that they can discover for themselves

cues.en: over multiple readings, or viewings if it's a movie.

cues.zh: 双份的简单可以是一种放松的体验，或者面向儿童的体验，
cues.en: A double helping of simple can be a relaxing experience, or one aimed at children,

cues.zh: 这绝不是贬低，人们喜欢简单有趣的娱乐故事。
cues.en: which isn't an insult by any means, people love simple entertaining stories.

cues.zh: 用复杂方式讲述的复杂故事很难做好，
cues.en: Complex stories told in a complex way are difficult to get right,

cues.en: since the complexity in both parts needs to be worth it. These can be train wrecks or masterpieces.

cues.zh: 它们往往可以被研究。做得好时，这里面有很多值得欣赏的地方。
cues.en: They can often be studied. There's a lot to enjoy here when it's done well.

cues.en: But this is the category that The Witness, and many other pretentious stories like it, falls into,

cues.en: and it's something that bothers me so much.

cues.zh: 许多精彩书籍的问题，往往在于它们通常很难读、
cues.en: The problem with many incredible books can come from how they're often difficult to read

cues.en: which some people can understandably struggle with (that's also my favorite book by the way).

cues.en: This idea of complexity equals worth can be infectious.

cues.zh: 这种想法会扎根：一样东西要想值得你花时间，
cues.en: The idea takes root that in order for something to be worth your time,

cues.zh: 就必须在某种程度上难以理解。
cues.en: that it has to be difficult to understand in some way.

cues.zh: 这些人没抓住重点。复杂性必须为书中的某些东西带来价值，
cues.en: These people are missing the point. The complexity needs to be worth it for something in the book,

cues.zh: 而不是为了复杂而复杂。
cues.en: not for the sake of complexity itself.

cues.zh: 你有很多故事都故意写得晦涩难懂。它们不喜欢给你信息。
cues.en: So you have so many stories that are intentionally obtuse. They don't like giving you information.

cues.zh: 它们甚至可能会说，知晓的神秘感和惊奇感
cues.en: They might even say that the mystery and wonder of knowing will

cues.zh: 总是比真正弄明白更令人愉悦，我觉得这是胡扯，
cues.en: always be more enjoyable than really finding out, which I think is bullshit,

cues.en: since there's already enough to wonder out in the world.

cues.zh: 不过，我同样确信有些杰出的故事能做到这一点。
cues.en: Although, again, I am certain that some exceptional stories could pull it off.

cues.zh: 但最糟糕的是，这会导致两种难以穿透的体验：

cues.en: They're light on details that might even contradict themselves in order to appear deep,

cues.zh: 结果就像试图抓住一条患癫痫的鱼，
cues.en: the result being something close to trying to hold on to a fish with epilepsy,

cues.zh: 你根本无从把握，这时你就只能形成自己的观点、自己的解读。
cues.en: you can't even begin to grasp it, which is when you're left with forming your own opinion, your own interpretation.

cues.zh: 因为这还有什么能比这更强大呢？你获得了所有这些信息
cues.en: Because what could be more powerful than that? You get all this information

cues.en: and get to decide what it all means to yourself, to YOU.

cues.zh: 然后你构建出自己喜欢的整套叙事，因为你当然会喜欢它；
cues.en: And you create this whole narrative that you like, because of course you're going to like it;

cues.en: all the while, you're building a positive association with the piece of art that's making you do this

cues.en: It's like forming a twisted relationship, in a way.

cues.zh: 你觉得自己很聪明，因为参与创造了它。
cues.en: You're feeling so smart, part of creating it.

cues.en: And if you like that sort of thing, then all right, I really don't.

cues.en: If I want to use my imagination to create a story, then I'll go do that on my own.

cues.en: When I experience a story I want an actual story with answers and meaning

cues.zh: 以及这些东西带来的所有后果。
cues.en: and all the ramifications of those things.
